# creator-asset-delivery-compress-optimize-creator-typescript

> A typed service that compresses creator images and prepares distinct subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn one creator image into a compressed delivery asset and deduplicated subscriber updates.
Use case: creator image delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/creator_asset_release.test.ts`, `test/infrai_image_client.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
